# Notice

These fixtures come from two MIT-licensed projects and are used only to test the
`workproof bullets` command.

- `portfolio-bank.md` is the public sample bank of JD Resume Tailor (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Dayesh Raval). Its facts are fictional.
- `past-resume.md` is the reference resume of GapToGrowth (MIT). Its names, companies, schools and numbers are fictional.
- `jd-ml.md` and `jd-backend.md` are the sample job descriptions of the two projects' README examples, as used in this repository's benchmark tasks T7 and T8.
